level_1.name: SYSTEM SPECIFICATIONS
level_1.rule: Implementation CANNOT contradict a higher-level specification without formal exception

authority_hierarchy.direction: Top-down authority. Lower levels implement, they do not define.

COLOR.scope: All color tokens, palettes, semantic mapping, expression variants

TYPOGRAPHY.scope: Font families, scale, weights, voice assignment, expression mapping

PHOTOGRAPHY.scope: Models, lighting, composition, crop, domains, color grading, governance

ICONOGRAPHY.scope: Icon registry, geometry, semantic colors, sizes, migration status

COMPONENTS.scope: Component taxonomy, states, spacing, surfaces, patterns, governance

AUDIENCE.source: S4 UI Component Language (Women/Men sections) + S1/S3 expression rules
AUDIENCE.scope: Women/Men differentiation rules, shared vs. divergent, prohibited patterns

AURA.source: S3 Photography (AURA) + S4 UI (AURA) + S1 Color (Aura Teal) + Icon System (AURA icons)
AURA.scope: AURA visual language, intelligence expression, prohibited aesthetics

GOVERNANCE.scope: All governance rules, change processes, AI agent rules, versioning

L0_SOUL.name: SOUL
L0_SOUL.description: Master visual + UX + governance authority. Immutable without formal SOUL revision.

L1_SYSTEM_SPEC.name: SYSTEM SPECIFICATION
L1_SYSTEM_SPEC.description: S1–S4 + Icon System. Defines WHAT the system is. Changes require Director approval.

L2_COMPONENT_SYSTEM.name: COMPONENT SYSTEM
L2_COMPONENT_SYSTEM.description: Component library, states, variants, patterns. Changes require Component Review.

L3_SCREEN.name: SCREEN COMPOSITION
L3_SCREEN.description: Screen-level composition using approved components. Implementation detail.

L4_IMPLEMENTATION.name: IMPLEMENTATION
L4_IMPLEMENTATION.description: Flutter code, widgets, tokens, themes. Must comply with L0–L3.

L5_EXPERIMENTAL.name: EXPERIMENTAL
L5_EXPERIMENTAL.description: Isolated prototypes. Cannot ship. Must follow promotion path to enter L2+.

authority_levels.rule: A lower level CANNOT silently contradict a higher level. Conflicts must be escalated via Conflict Resolution process.

DESIGN_REVIEW: New component variant with existing behavior

PATCH.definition: Backward-compatible fix. No visual/behavior change to spec.
examples: Token value correction to match spec

MINOR.definition: Backward-compatible addition. New capability within existing spec.

MAJOR.definition: Breaking change to spec or identity. Requires migration.

EXCEPTION.definition: Temporary deviation from spec for real case system cannot solve.
EXCEPTION.rule: Never silently become standard. Must have review date.

EXPERIMENTAL.definition: Isolated prototype. Not in production. Must be promoted or rejected.
EXPERIMENTAL.approval: DESIGN_REVIEW for prototype. DIRECTOR_REVIEW for promotion.

token_governance.rule: NO new token if existing token solves the case.
before_creating_token: 1. Search existing tokens (Token + GlowStoreTokens + S1/S2/S4 specs)
2. Determine why existing token doesn't serve the need
3. Verify reusability across 3+ use cases or strategic need
prohibited: Spacing tokens not on 4px base scale
Radius tokens not mapped to component type
Shadow tokens using black (must be warm neutral per S1)

categories.CORE: Foundation: spacing, radius, shadow, surface levels
categories.SEMANTIC: Meaning-driven: primary, secondary, error, success, focus, selected
categories.STATUS: State-driven: loading, disabled, error, warning, success

before_creating_component: 1. Does an equivalent component exist? (Search component inventory)
2. Can it be resolved via variant of existing component?
3. Is it reusable? (3+ use cases or strategic)
4. Does it have distinct behavior (not just visual)?
5. Does it have sufficient usage frequency?
6. Register: purpose, use_case, reusability, variants, dependencies, design_rationale

variant_allowed_when: Changes hierarchy (primary vs secondary vs tertiary)
Changes context (mobile vs desktop, Women vs Men, AURA)
Responds to repeated, documented need (3+ cases)

rules: NO Material/Cupertino when GlowIcon equivalent exists
NO individual SVG without registry entry
NO duplicate geometries
NO semantically ambiguous icons
NO using 'aura'/'glow'/'glowRecommendation' as universal AI synonyms
Each new icon requires: semantic name, purpose, geometry, context, accessibility, theme behavior, registry entry, documentation, visual validation
icon_governance.semantic_vs_visual: One geometry per semantic action. Color varies by audience/expression via S1 Icon Color Roles.

icon_migration_governance.current_state: M1-I2 Pilot A APPROVED. M1-I3 Pilot B APPROVED (97/100).
rules: Migration by phases only
Order: high-leverage components → navigation → screens → critical flows → exceptions
Each pilot requires: baseline, scope, risk, visual validation, functional validation, rollback plan, approval
NO automatic advancement from one pilot to next
Rollback capability mandatory at each phase
NO arbitrary colors introduced
Every new hue must classify: CORE, SEMANTIC, CONTEXTUAL, STATUS, EXCEPTION
If no justification → NO ADD
Prohibited: hardcoded brand colors, duplicated palettes, screen-specific brand colors
NO arbitrary font family
NO arbitrary font size
NO arbitrary weight
Hierarchy must remain consistent
Two voices only: EDITORIAL (Cormorant Garamond) + FUNCTIONAL (Manrope)
Supporting: DATA/METADATA (JetBrains Mono)
Differentiation via color/photography/composition/spacing — NOT font family
Every new photograph must respect: subject, composition, lighting, crop, ratio, context, audience, brand mood
Women: Use official female muse identity. No generic substitution
Men: Use official male muse identity. No generic substitution
AURA: Human context + light/geometry. No robots/chips/circuits/neon
Concierge: Personal, human, attentive. Not call center
Beauty/Men domains: Single photographic language, not 8/8 different styles
prohibited: Replacing official muse with generic stock

women_governance.principle: Women belongs to GLOWAPP MASTER SYSTEM. No independent design system.
women_governance.expression: Modern femininity + quiet luxury. Not 'pink beauty app.' Not overly glamorous stock beauty.

men_governance.principle: Men belongs to GLOWAPP MASTER SYSTEM. Must express QUIET MASCULINE LUXURY.
men_governance.note: Official male muse (Phase 1) is part of photographic language, not a component system.

aura_governance.principle: AURA belongs to GlowApp system. Must express QUIET INTELLIGENCE.
aura_governance.visual_presence: AURA does not need to be visually present on every screen. Appears when INTELLIGENCE IS RELEVANT. Subtle, organic, premium, intentional.

state_governance.rule: No arbitrary states. Every component must define behavior for all applicable states per S4 specification.

prohibited: Shipping without focus styles on interactive elements
Aura Teal on dark backgrounds (1.8:1 fails — documented exception in S1)
accessibility_governance.validation: Required at G3 (Validation) and G4 (Visual QA) gates

responsive_governance.rule: Every new component must define: mobile, tablet, desktop.
responsive_governance.prohibited: Layouts exclusively for one resolution without justification.

rules: Experiment does NOT auto-modify SOUL
Must be able to: PROTOTYPE → VALIDATE → APPROVE → PROMOTE → REJECT
Experimental code lives in separate branch/directory
No production dependencies on experimental code
Promotion follows change classification (MINOR/MAJOR)

exception_governance.exists_when: Current system cannot solve a real case.
exception_governance.rule: Never silently convert exception to standard. Review date mandatory.

checklist: BRAND — Does it express Quiet Luxury + Human Experience + Editorial Beauty + Intelligent Simplicity?
COLOR — S1 compliant? No arbitrary hues? Audience-adaptive?
TYPOGRAPHY — S2 compliant? Two voices? Correct scale/weight?
PHOTOGRAPHY — S3 compliant? Correct muse? Lighting? Composition?
ICON — GlowIcon system? Semantic color? Registry entry?
COMPONENT — S4 compliant? Existing component/variant used? States defined?
ACCESSIBILITY — Focus? Contrast? Semantic labels? Touch targets? Scaling? Motion?
AUDIENCE — Women/Men differentiation correct? No independent systems?
AURA — Quiet Intelligence? No cyberpunk? Aura Teal only?
SEMANTICS — Tokens/components used semantically? Not visually?

definition_of_done: 12. Documentation updated (WHAT, WHY, WHERE, HOW, VALIDATION, DECISION, DATE, VERSION)

ai_agent_governance.critical: This section governs ALL future AI agents working on GlowApp.
mandatory_steps: 4. AUDIT before modifying (existing code, tokens, components)
9. PRESERVE business logic (booking, payment, auth, backend)
11. DOCUMENT changes (WHAT, WHY, WHERE, HOW, VALIDATION, DECISION, DATE, VERSION)
12. STOP at ambiguity — ask, don't assume
forbidden_assumptions: "The existing code does X, so I'll do X"
"I'll add a quick token for this screen"
"Material Icons are fine for this one thing"

required_sections: PROHIBITIONS — What NOT to do (per this governance)
VALIDATION — How to verify (analyze, test, build, visual QA)
prompt_governance.rule: No major changes via ambiguous prompts. Every implementation prompt must be governance-compliant.

chat_governance.rule: GLOWAPP_SOUL.md must be loaded/consulted at start of any new visual development thread.
chat_governance.if_no_soul: Do NOT assume visual rules. First: READ SOUL.
chat_governance.session_requirement: Every visual work session begins with SOUL context.

GLOW_ICON_SYSTEM_v1_0.rule: Cannot be modified without specific ICON_SYSTEM_REVIEW

rules: NO removing component/token/icon without knowing consumers
Deprecation marker in code + documentation
Migration path documented before removal
Priority by: impact, risk, leverage
Legacy may remain temporarily (COMPLIANT / PARTIALLY_COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT / LEGACY / EXCEPTION)

quality_gates.G0_SCOPE: Scope defined, aligned to SOUL, no scope creep
quality_gates.G1_DESIGN: Design review passed (checklist complete), Director approval if required
quality_gates.G2_IMPLEMENTATION: Code complete, follows tokens/components, no hardcoded values
quality_gates.G3_VALIDATION: flutter analyze PASS, flutter test PASS, flutter build web --release PASS
quality_gates.G4_VISUAL_QA: Visual regression compared to spec. Mobile/Tablet/Desktop. Women/Men/AURA
quality_gates.rule: Cannot pass to next gate without completing current gate.

rollback_governance.rule: Never revert pre-existing work (M1-I3, other phases). Only revert the specific change scope.

every_approved_change_records: VALIDATION — Test results, visual QA, gates passed

soul_change_process: 3. IMPACT ANALYSIS — Affected specs, components, screens, migrations
6. UPDATE SPECIFICATION — Modify S1–S5 / Icon System as needed
9. VERSION BUMP — MINOR or MAJOR per versioning rules

conflict_resolution.rule: If code contradicts SOUL: DO NOT adapt SOUL automatically.
process: 2. DECIDE: FIX CODE (align to SOUL) OR SOUL REVISION (change identity)
3. EXISTING CODE HAS NO AUTHORITY OVER IDENTITY

classification: EXCEPTION — Documented deviation with review date
legacy_governance.rule: No immediate global migration required. Prioritize by: impact, risk, leverage.

governance_matrix.validation: WCAG AA audit + Screen reader test
